correctness.rationale: For X²=X and AX=λXA with nonzero λ≠1, comparison of AX²=λXAX=λ²X²A and AX=λXA forces AX=XA=0. Factor X through Q=Fq^n/im A to ker A, where multiplication is a Munn/sandwich operation with core diag(I_t,0_s), s=rank A−rank A², t=n−rank A−s. An idempotent [P B; C CB] is determined by an ordinary rank-r projection P and q^(2sr) compatible B,C lifts; its rank is r. For two lifts XY has rank(PQ), independent of lift variables. Counting image u-subspaces W by dim(W∩ker P)=u−v and complementary Q kernels yields exactly the displayed Gaussian-binomial trivariate coefficient, with support max(0,r+u−t)≤v≤min(r,u). Independent F3 2x2 projection enumeration (14 core projections) recovered for t=2,s=1 exactly 190 idempotents and all 36100 ordered pair rank triples, including 2916 zero and 8748 rank-one products among rank-one pairs.
